description: This file defines API interaction methods for a web frontend, including functions for CRUD operations on work items, comments, and handling authentication-related headers and errors.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a given API path is public (does not require Authorization), such as login or signup endpoints.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Constructs request headers, adding Authorization when needed.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles error responses from fetch calls, including auto-logout on 401 and redirect to login.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend with proper headers and parses the response.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body to the backend.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request, including optional query parameters.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body to the backend.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item by project_id and item id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific work item, sourcing author ID from localStorage and allowing optional display name.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (task or bug), including creator info from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for a given API path.
